entity.description: One user-written JEXL script: its body, the profile it runs under and a sample input to try it on.

field.name: scriptProfile
field.description: EXPRESSION (one expression, no loops) or SCRIPT (statements, loops, lambdas).

field.name: scriptBody
field.description: The JEXL source; it reads only input.

field.name: sampleInputJson
field.description: JSON the script is tried on before it is saved, and its input when a deployment names no input service.

entity.description: A user script put to work: on its cron (read in timeZone) the input service reads the input, the script runs, and the delivery service receives what it returned. The script never does I/O itself. Run by org.moqui.jexl.ScriptDeploymentScheduler (moqui.jexl.ScriptServices.run#DueUserScriptDeployments).

field.name: timeZone
field.description: Zone id the cron is read in; the server's zone when empty.

field.name: inputServiceName
field.description: A service implementing moqui.jexl.ScriptServices.read#UserScriptDeploymentInput, called with scriptDeployment (Map) and userScriptId, returning input (any JSON-shaped value) and optionally inputSummary; no input means nothing runs (NO_INPUT). When empty the script's sampleInputJson is the input.

field.name: deliveryServiceName
field.description: A service implementing moqui.jexl.ScriptServices.deliver#UserScriptDeploymentResult, called with scriptDeployment (Map) and scriptResult (what the script returned), and only when the result is not empty; an error it adds marks the run NOT_DELIVERED, its message out-parameter is recorded.

field.name: nextRunDate
field.description: When it is next due; set on save and moved forward as each run is claimed.

field.name: lastRunStatus
field.description: DELIVERED, NOTHING_TO_DELIVER, SCRIPT_ERROR, NO_INPUT, NOT_DELIVERED, SCRIPT_MISSING, WAITING or EXPIRED.

field.name: lastRunUnits
field.description: Work units the last run's script used.
